# Pragvance.ai

> Practical AI. Built to advance your business.

Pragvance helps you staff a Grok Bot department — roles, skills, tools, routines — and ships apps & SaaS when the work needs a product.

## Offers
- Agent Swarm (primary): $99/mo on Skool — https://www.skool.com/the-swarm-2120
  Weekly live training to build a Grok Bot agent team. Classroom stays on Skool.
- Shadow Lab (upsell): $497 seat / $997 month — book via https://pragvance.ai/contact
  Live high-touch seats. Not a second school on this site.
- AI Reality Check: free readiness assessment at /assessment
- Apps: portfolio including MinutesIntel.ai (https://minutesintel.ai); custom builds via contact
